name: impl-flow
description: Interviews you into an adversarially reviewed use-case document, breaks the feature down into commit-sized implementation plans and executes them with subagents sized to each plan's complexity. Run /impl-flow:spec (design+plan) and /impl-flow:implement independently, or /impl-flow:all for the full pipeline in one go. For changes to something that already exists, /impl-flow:fix is a lighter fix mode that revises the existing use-case document and hunts for what a partial fix would leave behind.
